messages:
sophia: starting nightly kbench sweep for candidate kernels on GCP h100/ampere pool. seqlen sweep: 8,32,128,512; batch sizes 1..8. tagging @marco @anya. kicking off now.

marco: thanks. are we gating arch-specific picks (ampere vs h100) differently or using same policy?

sophia: using arch-aware picks. autotuner will prefer family-specific kernels; canary policy = fallback-policy=compat if perf diff < 3%.

perf-bot: run queued: kbench/2119876543 (sweep-id: kb-2119) started on runner-14

anya: fyi i pushed a tweak to kvcache prefetch in ff8 branch — might affect long-seq path.

jamie: noted. include ff8 in the candidate set?

sophia: included. command used:
```bash
./kbench --sweep seqlen=8,32,128,512 --batches=1-8 --candidates=ff8,ff7,baseline --arch=ampere,h100 --out=artifacts/kb-2119
```

perf-bot: kb-2119 finished. summary:
- ff8: wins at seqlen 512 (+12% throughput) on h100
- ff7: best at seqlen 32 (+5%)
- baseline: stable at short seqlen
Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/jobs/kbench/kb-2119/artifacts/heatmap.png
Full CSV: https://ci.redwood/jobs/kbench/kb-2119/artifacts/kb-2119.csv

marco: heatmap shows a weird dip for ff8 @ seqlen 128 on ampere. any logs we can look at?

sophia: logs attached: https://ci.redwood/jobs/kbench/kb-2119/artifacts/kb-2119-logs.tar.gz
snippet:
```
[runner-14][ff8][seq=128][ampere] kernel-select: chosen=matmul_kv_v2, latency=4.9ms, fallback=0
[runner-14][ff8][seq=128][h100] kernel-select: chosen=matmul_kv_v3, latency=2.1ms
```

anya: matmul_kv_v2 is the new microkernel we added last week. suspect register spill or scheduling issue on ampere. i'll repro locally.

jamie: for CI gating, do we want to block ff8 until this is fixed? +12% at long seq is great but mid-seq regression is concerning.

sophia: @anya can you take ownership? propose adding a small lock-step microbench for seq=128 to nightly triage to catch this earlier.

anya: will do. quick local microprobe shows +30% L1 misses at seq=128 on ampere for matmul_kv_v2. looks like a bad register allocation path when threads=4.

perf-bot: Issue created: PERF-3142 "ff8 mid-seq ampere regression" linked to kb-2119

marco: :thumbsup: i vote for temporary gating rule: require no >5% regression at any seqlen vs baseline on the same arch.

sophia: agree. i'll add gating rule to kbench CI config and re-run kb-2119 after the fix lands.

jamie: also add a kernel-validator test: `seq=128,batch=4,arch=ampere` to the PR checks.

sophia: done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2786

perf-bot: CI status: PR 2786 passed unit tests, awaiting merge

anya: patch for matmul_kv_v2 landed in ff8 branch. will kick off a re-sweep after merge.

perf-bot: kb-2119-rerun queued (trigger: PR 2789)

sophia: thanks team. we'll watch the rerun for flakiness and mark this thread resolved once the rerun confirms stable behavior across seqlen.
